BrochureContent.Content:
Large 3 Bedroom Apartment

Welcome to The Oslo, where luxury and comfort seamlessly blend in our thoughtfully designed 1-bedroom apartments in the heart of Sandyford, Dublin 18. Inspired by the principles of Hygge style, our apartments offer a harmonious living experience that radiates warmth and elegance.

Upon entering your 3-bedroom oasis, you'll be greeted by a soothing colour palette of Cashmere walls complemented by the inviting warmth of Derby Oak flooring. This carefully chosen combination reflects the essence of Scandinavian and Hygge design a perfect fusion of clean lines, natural elements, and an unwavering focus on comfort.

Large floor-to-ceiling windows grace your living space, inviting an abundance of natural light to create an airy, inviting atmosphere. The interior layout has been meticulously crafted to provide a cozy and relaxing environment, offering a stylish retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life.

At The Oslo, we place nature at the heart of our design philosophy. Nestled at the base of the Dublin Mountains, we draw inspiration from our surroundings, effortlessly blending the urban environment with stunning views of the mountains and Dublin Bay. It's a place where city living coexists harmoniously with the beauty of the natural world.

In addition to the beautifully designed interiors, residents of The Oslo have exclusive access to our spacious Garden Lounge, which boasts a private garden oasis where you can unwind amidst lush greenery. Our landscaped communal areas seamlessly connect you to the LUAS transport system and the thriving Sandyford Business District, ensuring you're never far from the city's key attractions.

Each 3-bedroom apartment at The Oslo has been carefully designed to prioritise natural, comfortable living. Our interiors feature the best in Scandinavian sustainable design, from natural fabrics to calming colour schemes that foster a sense of serenity. And when you step onto your spacious balcony, you'll enjoy a front-row seat to the ever-changing beauty of nature throughout the seasons.

The Oslo isn't just a place to live; it's a lifestyle that embraces the principles of Hygge, where you can find tranquillity, connect with nature, and relish the simplicity of comfortable and sophisticated living. Welcome to The Oslo, where every day is a testament to the art of elegant city living in harmony with the natural world.

Every apartment comes with complimentary WiFi and television package.

**Please note: 

1) There are multiple property types available in this development. The photos shown here may not be of the actual unit available but represent the standard of finish. .

2) The rent advertised on the individual property ads represent the starting rent for these property types. Rents will vary throughout the development depending on the specific property type. Not all the available properties and rents are listed here; please use those available at viewings. 

3) The overall BER Rating on this development is A2- A3. An individual BER cert for your specific apartment is available on move in, upon request. 

4) The amenity spaces are subject to varying completion dates and are tied in with the overall development completion time frame and may be subject to change.
